```{r datafunc}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# merge all datasets by subject ID
merge_by_id <- function(datasets, id_var = "SEQN") {
  reduce(datasets, full_join, by = id_var)
}

# Subset to subjects with complete data for given variables,
# and keep only those variables (plus the ID)
subset_complete <- function(data, vars, id_var = "SEQN") {
  data %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_var, vars)))
    
}

na_filter <- function(data, vars)  {
   data %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
}


factorize_vars <- function(data, vars) {
  data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(vars), as.factor))
}

clean_drop <- function(data) {
  # Dictionary of codes to drop
  special_codes <- list(
    DMDEDUC2 = 9,
    DMDMARTZ = c(77, 99),
    ALQ151   = c(7, 9),
    BPQ020   = c(7, 9),
    BPQ080   = c(7, 9),
    DIQ010   = c(7, 9),
    SMQ020   = c(7, 9),
    PAD680   = c(7777, 9999),
    WHD050   = c(7777, 9999),
    WHQ070   = c(7, 9),
    SMD650   = c(999),
    PAD790Q  = c(7777, 9999),
    WHD020   = c(7777, 9999),
    DBQ940   = 9
  )
  
  cleaned <- data
  dropped <- data[0, ]  
  
  # Loop through variables and remove rows with special codes
  for (var in names(special_codes)) {
    if (var %in% names(cleaned)) {
      bad_rows <- cleaned[[var]] %in% special_codes[[var]]
      if (any(bad_rows)) {
        dropped <- rbind(dropped, cleaned[bad_rows, ])
        cleaned <- cleaned[!bad_rows, ]
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(list(cleaned = cleaned, dropped = dropped))
}

```

```{r subset}
all <- merge_by_id(list(alq, bmx, bpq, demo, diq, paq, smq, whq, mcq, dbq, crp,slp, nud1, nud2), id_var = "SEQN")

varsToUse<- c("RIAGENDR", "RIDAGEYR", "RIDRETH3", "DMDEDUC2", "DMDMARTZ", "INDFMPIR", "BMXBMI", "BPQ020", "BPQ080", "SMQ020", "PAD680", "WHQ070", "LBXHSCRP", "SLD012", "DR1TFIBE", "DR1TSUGR", "DR1TATOC", "DR1TVARA", "DR1TVC", "DR1TMAGN", "DR1TSODI", "DR1TSFAT", "DR1TCHOL", "DR1TATOA", "DR1TFOLA", "DR2TFIBE", "DR2TSUGR", "DR2TATOC", "DR2TVARA", "DR2TVC", "DR2TMAGN", "DR2TSODI", "DR2TSFAT", "DR2TCHOL", "DR2TATOA", "DR2TFOLA")

varsneNA <-  c("RIAGENDR", "RIDAGEYR", "RIDRETH3", "DMDEDUC2", "DMDMARTZ", "INDFMPIR", "BMXBMI", "BPQ020", "BPQ080", "SMQ020", "PAD680", "WHQ070", "LBXHSCRP","SLD012", "DR1TFIBE","DR1TSUGR", "DR1TATOC", "DR1TVARA", "DR1TVC", "DR1TMAGN", "DR1TSODI", "DR1TSFAT", "DR1TCHOL", "DR1TATOA", "DR1TFOLA", "DR2TFIBE", "DR2TSUGR", "DR2TATOC", "DR2TVARA", "DR2TVC", "DR2TMAGN", "DR2TSODI", "DR2TSFAT", "DR2TCHOL", "DR2TATOA", "DR2TFOLA")

varsFactors <- c("RIAGENDR", "RIDRETH3", "DMDEDUC2", "DMDMARTZ", "BPQ020",
"BPQ080", "SMQ020", "WHQ070")

analysis <- subset_complete(all, varsToUse)
analysis.na <- na_filter(analysis, varsneNA)

analysis2 <- clean_drop(analysis.na)
nhanes.clean <- factorize_vars(analysis2$cleaned, varsFactors)
analysis_dropped <- analysis2$dropped

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
df <- as.data.frame(nhanes.clean, check.names = FALSE) 

dfcrp <- df %>%
  filter(LBXHSCRP <= 10)

dfcrp <- dfcrp %>%
  mutate(
    crp_binary = ifelse(LBXHSCRP >= 0 & LBXHSCRP <= 3, 0, 1)
  )
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nutrients <- c("TFIBE", "TSUGR", "TATOC", "TVARA", "TVC", "TMAGN", "TSODI", "TSFAT", "TCHOL", "TATOA", "TFOLA")

for (nutrient in nutrients) {
  var_name <- paste0(nutrient, "_avg")
  day1_var <- paste0("DR1", nutrient)
  day2_var <- paste0("DR2", nutrient)
  
  dfcrp[[var_name]] <- rowMeans(dfcrp[, c(day1_var, day2_var)], na.rm = TRUE)
}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
decile_breaks <- quantile(dfcrp$TFIBE_avg, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/6), na.rm = TRUE)

combined_breaks <- c(0.35, 8.95, 15.0999, 23.7, 82.65)

dfcrp$fiber_Bin <- cut(
  dfcrp$TFIBE_avg,
  breaks = unique(decile_breaks), 
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = FALSE 
)
dfcrp$fiber_Bin <- factor(dfcrp$fiber_Bin, ordered = TRUE)
dfcrp$crp_binary <- factor(dfcrp$crp_binary)

```

```{r fit}

#library(CERFIT)

set.seed(863)

fit <- CERFIT(crp_binary ~ RIAGENDR + RIDAGEYR + RIDRETH3 + DMDEDUC2 + DMDMARTZ + INDFMPIR + BMXBMI + BPQ020 + BPQ080 + SMQ020 + WHQ070 + PAD680 + SLD012 + TSUGR_avg + TATOC_avg + TVARA_avg + TVC_avg + TMAGN_avg + TSODI_avg + TSFAT_avg + TCHOL_avg + TATOA_avg + TFOLA_avg | fiber_Bin,
              method = "observational",
              PropForm = "GBM",
              data = dfcrp,
              mtry = 11,
              oob = TRUE,
              ntrees = 800)

depth <- MinDepth(fit)
depth <- as.data.frame(depth)
depth$Variable <- rownames(depth)
```

```{r, table 1}
range.tab <- table(decile_breaks)
range.df <- data.frame(
  fiber_Bin = seq_len(length(decile_breaks) - 1),
  Lower = decile_breaks[-length(decile_breaks)],
  Upper = decile_breaks[-1]
)
pct <- sub("%", "", rownames(range.df))      # remove %
pct <- as.numeric(pct)                       # convert to numeric
pct <- sprintf("%.2f%%", pct)     
rownames(range.df) <- pct

kable(
  range.df,
  format   = "latex",

  caption  = "Fiber bins and their corresponding ranges.",
  align    = c("c", "r", "r"),
  digits   = 2
) %>%
```

```{r plot3}
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
ite.l <- as.data.frame(ite) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = "Level_Fiber", values_to = "ITE")

medians <- ite.l %>%
  group_by(Level_Fiber) %>%
  summarize(med = median(ITE, na.rm = TRUE))

medians <- medians %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Median = ", round(med, 2))
    )

violin.fig <- ggplot(ite.l, aes(x = Level_Fiber, y = ITE, fill = Level_Fiber)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE,  fill = "gray80", color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, fill = "white",
    color = "black") +
  
  geom_text(data = medians,
            aes(y = 0.5,                  
                label = label),    
                   
            hjust = 0.7,                 
            size = 3.5,                 
            color = "black") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Violin Plots of ITE by Dietary Fiber Intake Level",
    x = "Fiber Intake",
    y = "Predicted ITE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(violin.fig)
```

```{r vitCplot}
dfite <- cbind(ite, dfcrp)
dfite_long <- as.data.frame(dfite) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`y2-y1`, `y3-y1`,`y4-y1`,`y5-y1`,`y6-y1`), 
               names_to = "Level_Fiber", values_to = "ITE")

vitC_breaks <- quantile(dfcrp$TVC_avg, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3), na.rm = TRUE)

dfite_long <- dfite_long %>%
  mutate(
    vitC_Level = case_when(
      TVC_avg < 40.49 ~ "Low (<40.49)",
      TVC_avg >= 40.49 & TVC_avg < 91.916 ~ "Middle (40.49–91.916)",
      TVC_avg >= 91.916 ~ "High (≥91.916)"
    ),
    vitC_Level = factor(vitC_Level, 
                         levels = c("Low (<40.49)", "Middle (40.49–91.916)", "High (≥91.916)")),
  
  
  Level_Fiber = factor(Level_Fiber)
  
  )

vitC.plot <- ggplot(dfite_long, aes(x = factor(Level_Fiber), y = ITE, color = vitC_Level)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.15, width = 0.2, size = 1) +  # scattered individual ITEs
  geom_smooth(aes(group = vitC_Level, linetype = vitC_Level),
              method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +  # smoothed trend
  scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.9) +
  scale_linetype_discrete() +
  labs(
    x = "Fiber Level",
    y = "ITE",
    color = "Vitamin C Level",
    linetype = "Vitamin C Level",
    title = "Relationship between ITE and Fiber Level",
    subtitle = "Grouped by Vitamin C Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(vitC.plot)

```

```{r optSummary}
dfite <- cbind(ite, dfcrp)

long_ite <- pivot_longer(
  dfite,
  cols = c(`y2-y1`, `y3-y1`,`y4-y1`,`y5-y1`,`y6-y1`),
  names_to = "Level_Fiber",
  values_to = "ITE"
)

opt_ite <- long_ite %>%
  group_by(SEQN) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = ITE, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

summary_opt <- opt_ite %>%
  group_by(Level_Fiber) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(), 
    ITE = mean(ITE, na.rm=TRUE),
    CRP = mean(LBXHSCRP, na.rm=TRUE),
    BMI = mean(BMXBMI, na.rm=TRUE),
    Poverty_Ratio = mean(INDFMPIR, na.rm=TRUE),
    Sugar = mean(TSUGR_avg, na.rm=TRUE),
    Magnesium = mean(TMAGN_avg, na.rm=TRUE),
    Folate = mean(TFOLA_avg, na.rm=TRUE),
    Vitamin_A = mean(TVARA_avg, na.rm=TRUE),
    Vitamin_C = mean(TVC_avg, na.rm=TRUE)

  ) %>%
arrange(Level_Fiber)

print(summary_opt)

summary_rotated <- summary_opt %>%
  # make it long: one row per (variable, Level_Fiber)
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Level_Fiber,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  # optional: order the variables the way you like
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(
      Variable,
      levels = c(
        "N", "ITE", "CRP", "BMI",
        "Poverty_Ratio", "Sugar", "Magnesium",
        "Folate", "Vitamin_A", "Vitamin_C"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "N", "ITE", "CRP", "BMI",
        "Poverty ratio", "Sugar", "Magnesium",
        "Folate", "Vitamin A", "Vitamin C"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Level_Fiber) %>%
  # now go wide: columns = fiber levels, rows = variables
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Level_Fiber,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  # make sure Variable is back to plain character for printing
  mutate(Variable = as.character(Variable))

kable(
  summary_rotated,
  format   = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "Summary of average outcomes by optimal fiber level",
  digits   = 3
)
  
```

```{r prev3}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1)
ite.dfcrp <- cbind(ite, dfcrp)
rand.subjid <- sample_n(ite.dfcrp, 10)
rand.subjid$SEQN <- as.factor(rand.subjid$SEQN)
rand.subjid$q1 <- 0

rand.renamed <- rand.subjid %>%
  rename(
    q2 = `y2-y1`,
    q3 = `y3-y1`,
    q4 = `y4-y1`,
    q5 = `y5-y1`,
    q6 = `y6-y1`
  )

long_rand <- pivot_longer(
  rand.renamed,
  cols = c(q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6),
  names_to = "Level_Fiber",
  values_to = "ITE"
)

lowest_ite <- long_rand %>%
  group_by(SEQN) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = ITE, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

actual_lookup <- rand.renamed %>%
  select(SEQN, fiber_Bin) 
actual_lookup <- actual_lookup %>%
  mutate(xfiber_Bin = case_when(
    fiber_Bin == 1 ~ "q1",
    fiber_Bin == 2 ~ "q2",
    fiber_Bin == 3 ~ "q3",
    fiber_Bin == 4 ~ "q4",
     fiber_Bin == 5 ~ "q5",
     fiber_Bin == 6 ~ "q6",
    TRUE ~ as.character(fiber_Bin) 
  ))

square_data <- long_rand %>%
  inner_join(actual_lookup, by = "SEQN") %>%
  filter(Level_Fiber == xfiber_Bin)

# overlap_data <- merge(
#   overlap_data,
#   long_rand[, c("SEQN", "Level_Fiber", "ITE")],
#   by = c("SEQN", "Level_Fiber")
# )

# Find where the lowest ITE and the actual (square) data overlap
overlap_data <- lowest_ite %>%
  inner_join(square_data, by = c("SEQN", "Level_Fiber"), suffix = c("", ".sq"))

# Optional: If you want to see how many matches you found
print(paste("Number of matches found:", nrow(overlap_data)))
```

```{r plotv3}

ite.rand.plot <- ggplot(
  data = long_rand,
  aes(x = Level_Fiber, y = ITE, group = SEQN, color = SEQN)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +

  geom_point(
    data = lowest_ite,
    aes(shape = "Optimal"),
    fill = "black",
    color = "black",

    aes(shape = "Optimal = Actual"),

    stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = square_data,
    aes(shape = "Actual"),
    fill = "black",
    color = "black",
    size = 2,

      "Actual" = 22,

    )
  ) +
  
   guides(color = "none") +

  labs(
    title = "ITE for 10 Random Subjects (Optimal ITE Circled; Actual Fiber Level Square)",
    x = "Fiber Level",
    y = "ITE Value"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(ite.rand.plot)
```
